City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 26, 2016 -
06:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the October 12, 2016 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2016-10-26 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2016-10-26 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
Public Utility Easement on City owned portion of Somerset Avenue to AT&T, Cox Communications, and San Diego Gas and Electric Company (SDG&E). Contact Person: Senior Civil Engineer Maher
Authorize the Public Works Director to execute easement grants per Attachment 2 of the agenda report, to AT&T, Cox Communications and SDG&E.
2016-10-26 Item 08C Easement Grants on Somerset Ave
8D.
Design Services Contract for Drainage Improvements on Vulcan Avenue. Contact Person: Civil Engineer Widelski
1) Authorize the Public Works Director to execute a contract, and any necessary amendments and time extensions, with Tetra Tech in the amount of $305,710, plus 10% contingencies to design the Vulcan Avenue Drainage Improvements Project (WD16A), for a total contract amount not to exceed $336,281; and 2) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2016-99 entitled, â€œA Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2016-17 Adopted Budgetâ€ (Attachment 1), to appropriate an additional $17,239 to the Vulcan Avenue Drainage Improvements Project.
2016-10-26 Item 08D Vulcan Ave. Drainage
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Parks Master Plan for Parks, Beaches, Trails, and Open Space. Contact Person: Parks and Recreation Director Campbell
1) Review the Parks Master Plan final draft; 2) Provide input on the Parks Master Plan final draft; and 3) Approve the Parks Master Plan final draft.
2016-10-26 Item 10A Parks Master Plan
10B.
Review and discussion on contact with the local school district superintendents, the San Dieguito Alliance and Sheriff's Department regarding what is currently being done in regards to drug prevention and education, what the trends are for Encinitas, the potential for partnering projects for drug prevention and education, and the cost of providing school site officers. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst McSeveney
That Council receive the report and provide possible direction to staff.
2016-10-26 Item 10B Drug Education
10C.
Consideration of correspondence dated October 6, 2016 from David W. Hutchinson addressed to the City Clerk (received via email) regarding alleged Brown Act violations and possible direction to staff.
2016-10-26 Item 10C Hutchinson Letter
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
11A.
State legislative update. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst McSeveney
This is an informational report and no action is required.
2016-10-26 Item 11A Legislative Update
11B.
Update on the activation of the Pacific View site. (There is no written agenda report)

ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON NOVEMBER 9, 2016
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
